svg.title: Impact oscillator simulation traces
svg.desc: The recorded external force, position and velocity are plotted over time. The oscillator remains in its sole location. At downward zero crossings of position the velocity reverses and loses magnitude; dashed marks show exact pre- and post-impact values.
